examples.title: Composed table
examples.description: Use native table parts and a caption. The frame owns horizontal scrolling for narrow screens.

examples.title: Sort actual records
examples.description: useTableSort owns immutable ordered rows. onSortChange connects the header button; the third activation and Reset return to input order.

examples.title: All row densities
examples.description: sm, md and lg remain available; md is the unchanged default. withoutBorder hides only the outer border.

examples.title: Loading and empty states
examples.description: TableBody renders the requested skeleton counts while loading. TableEmpty supports a custom message in a native cell.

examples.title: Sticky header and column
examples.description: stickyHeader needs a bounded frame height. sticky cells remain visible during horizontal scrolling.

examples.title: Explicit row selection
examples.description: The parent owns selected IDs and checkboxes. Stable row keys keep selection attached to the record when it moves.

examples.title: Wrapped content
examples.description: wrapContent is optional. Long cell copy wraps rather than using the default single-line presentation.
